source.title: Belfast Telegraph, 2 June 1967, p. 8 ("Sion tops the poll: rural elections with 96 pc"); Belfast News-Letter, 2 June 1967, p. 2 ("Poll surprises in many areas")
source.publisher: Belfast Telegraph (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: Read on the page image of the Belfast Telegraph, 2 June 1967, p. 8 (council-audit, Nov 2026): 'Owenreagh—Wm. J. McCloskey (Nat.) 110. Alexander Robinson (U.) 83. Maj. 27. Electorate 205. Total poll 196. Spoiled votes three'.

note: Triennial election, polled Thursday 1 June 1967. Four divisions were contested in the results printed; Scriggan, listed as a contest at nomination, does not appear in the result reports and is not recorded. McCloskey elected; majority 27; 95.6 pc poll.
correctionNote: Corrected from the page image of the Belfast Telegraph, 2 June 1967, p. 8 (council-audit, Nov 2026): 'Wm. J. McCloskey' as printed, and the printed electorate, total poll, spoiled votes and majority recorded (they reconcile: 110 + 83 + 3 = 196).
